scripts.npm:check: tsc -p scripts/npm/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json && oxlint scripts/npm packages/cli/src && oxfmt --check scripts/npm packages/cli package.json
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/typescript build && bun run --filter "@boxdb/*-adapter" build
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/typescript test && bun run --filter "@boxdb/*-adapter" test
scripts.check: bun run --cwd packages/typescript check && bun run --filter "@boxdb/*-adapter" check
